findings.title: No project license chosen; OpenAPI info.license missing
findings.evidence: Forge check openapi-lint (receipt d32cebdd-aa5b-4ae1-9b25-f9dc55f5b7f7) reports warning info-license at docs/api/openapi.yaml:2:1. The repository has no LICENSE file; docs/spec.md lists the license as an open question.
findings.impact: Reviewers and reusers cannot tell under which terms the project code may be used; the contract lint keeps one warning.
findings.precautions: Only the repository owner chooses a license. Vendored skills keep their own MIT notices regardless of the project license.
findings.verification: After a license is chosen: add LICENSE, set info.license in openapi.yaml and rerun npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.54.2 lint docs/api/openapi.yaml.
